create_model_Cell: create a Cell model with id, rawcell_id, and label fields for document annotation
create_model_Cluster: create a Cluster model with model, type, bbox, cell_ids, merged, and id fields
create_model_Table: create a Table model with cell_id, label, rows, and cols fields for table annotations
create_model_Annotation: create an Annotation model containing lists of AnnotPredItem annotations, predictions, and reports
build_annotation_item: build an AnnotPredItem with cells, clusters, tables, and source for document annotation data
